paragraphs: From Roscommon test centre, set off along Circular Road and take your first left, staying on Circular Road
You will meet a roundabout very quickly, so take the 1st exit to continue on Circular Road
Keep your observations sharp because a second roundabout follows shortly after, and again you take the 1st exit onto Circular Road
Continue along Circular Road for roughly 300 metres to the next roundabout, taking the 1st exit once more
Another roundabout follows, and you again take the 1st exit, staying on Circular Road for about 400 metres
Use this stretch to practice smooth gear changes and steady lane discipline
Join the N61 at the next roundabout by taking the 1st exit
Continue for nearly 500 metres to a further roundabout where you take the 1st exit onto the Roscommon Rural road
Take the next left toward Roscommon and follow the unnamed rural road for about 1.4 km before turning left onto the L1808
This is a good section to practice rural road positioning and safe use of speed
After roughly 2.2 km, you will meet a roundabout back on Circular Road
Take the 1st exit and continue through the following roundabouts, taking the 1st exit each time as you work your way around
At the next roundabout take the 1st exit onto Athlone Road and follow it for about 1.4 km
Turn right onto Golf Links Road take the 1st right into Ardsallagh Woods for a short estate section
This is where you may be asked to complete a turnabout, so practice a controlled U-turn using the full width of the road with good all-round observation before setting off again
Come back out to Golf Links Road and turn right
Continue on Golf Links Road for about a kilometre
Turn left onto Antogher Road after a short distance
Turn right into Abbeytown and approach the roundabout, taking the 2nd exit onto Circular Road
Follow Circular Road for the final stretch back toward Roscommon test centre, keeping your speed low and your mirror checks frequent as you return
